recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes FHIR-13463 on the active Library model-definition surfaces while leaving the already-correct DeviceMetric StructureDefinition and example unchanged. The remaining source/fhir.ini DeviceMetric.measurementPeriod entry is an R4/R5 change-map note, not current resource metadata.
issue_request: FHIR-13463 was Published with a Persuasive resolution for R5. It requested changing DeviceMetric.measurementPeriod from the wrong Timing type to a Quantity and DEV comments clarified the approved element name measurementFrequency, short text, and definition.
initial_application: The February 20, 2023 FHIR-13463 commits changed the primary DeviceMetric StructureDefinition to DeviceMetric.measurementFrequency with Quantity type and updated the DeviceMetric example. Those commits did not update the active FHIR and QUICK Library model-definition content, which still exposed measurementPeriod as Timing.
additional_context: DeviceMetric and Library are both active current-build resources. The Library examples list and publish.ini show the FHIR and QUICK model-definition content XML files are built/published examples. A prior combined-branch FHIR-39432 reconciliation updated adjacent DeviceMetric category/calibration model metadata in the same files but left the measurement element stale. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence decision.
reconciliation: Changed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml to expose measurementFrequency as FHIR.Quantity, changed source/library/library-quick-model-definition-content.xml to expose measurementFrequency as System.Quantity, and regenerated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml so its embedded Library.data attachment matches the edited FHIR model-info content.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: DeviceMetric model-info element changed from measurementPeriod/FHIR.Timing to measurementFrequency/FHIR.Quantity.
source/library/library-quick-model-definition-content.xml: QUICK DeviceMetric model-info element changed from measurementPeriod/QUICK.Timing to measurementFrequency/System.Quantity.
source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml: embedded FHIR model-definition Library data resynchronized from the edited content XML.
